name: acad-annotations
description: AutoCAD text and annotation entities: single-line DBText, multi-line MText with inline formatting, leaders and multi-leaders (MLeader) with text or block content, basic Tables built from row/column data, points with point styles, and text style management. All write operations require the AcadMcp .NET plugin loaded inside an open AutoCAD session and run inside a single transaction with a document lock.
intent_examples: make text readable over a hatch
split a note into two columns
wyrownaj tekst do srodka bez przesuwania

tools_summary.name: add_dbtext
tools_summary.description: Add a single-line text entity (DBText / DTEXT) at the given position. Height defaults to 2.5 mm; alignment is one of Left, Center, Right, Middle, BaseLeft, BaseCenter, BaseRight, TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight, BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight.

tools_summary.name: add_mleader_block
tools_summary.description: Add a multi-leader (MLeader) whose content is a block reference (e.g. detail bubble). The block must already be defined in the drawing.

tools_summary.name: add_mleader_text
tools_summary.description: Add a multi-leader (MLeader) with MText content. Single segment from arrowTip to textPosition; the dogleg between the leader and the text block is enabled by default.

tools_summary.name: add_mtext
tools_summary.description: Add a multi-line text (MText) entity at the given position. widthFactor=0 disables word-wrap (auto width); attachmentPoint is e.g. TopLeft / MiddleCenter / BottomRight (defaults to TopLeft). Inline MText formatting codes are passed through (\\Pnewline, \\Lunderline, \\C2red).

tools_summary.name: add_table
tools_summary.description: Insert an AutoCAD Table at the given position with rows × cols cells. Optional 2D data array fills cell text top-to-bottom, left-to-right. rowHeight/colWidth are in current units.

tools_summary.name: background_mask_mtext
tools_summary.description: Put an opaque mask behind MText so it stays readable over hatching, an xref or a busy plan - AutoCAD's background mask. Give either color for a fixed colour, or useDrawingBackground true to follow whatever the drawing background is, which is what survives being plotted on white and viewed on black; the two contradict each other and passing both is refused. scaleFactor is AutoCAD's 1 to 5, where 1 hugs the text exactly, and anything below it would leave the text poking out of its own mask. The mask does not change the MText's extents, so the entity still measures the same - look at the drawing to see it.
intent: make text readable over a hatch

tools_summary.name: create_text_style
tools_summary.description: Create a new text style (TextStyleTableRecord) by name with the given font (.shx or TTF face name). height=0 makes the style annotative-friendly (text height set per-entity).

tools_summary.name: delete_text_style
tools_summary.description: Delete a text style by name. Standard cannot be deleted; the style must be unused (no DBText/MText/Dim references).

tools_summary.name: export_text_content
tools_summary.description: Write every piece of text in the drawing to a file - single-line text, MText, MLeaders, block attributes, table cells and dimension overrides. format csv carries handle, type, layer and text; txt is the text alone, one item per line. The text column is what a reader sees, with MText formatting codes already resolved. Written UTF-8 with a byte order mark so a spreadsheet opens accented characters intact rather than as mojibake, and the file is checked to be non-empty before this reports success.

tools_summary.name: find_replace_text
tools_summary.description: Find and replace text across the whole drawing - AutoCAD's FIND. Covers single-line text, MText, MLeaders, block attributes, table cells and dimension text overrides. Every write is READ BACK and anything that did not take is listed as skipped rather than counted. Text carrying MText formatting codes is only changed when the pattern matches the same number of times in the stored string as in the rendered one; otherwise the replacement would be landing inside a code - changing a font rather than the words - and it is skipped with that reason. Pass dryRun true to see exactly what would change without writing anything.

tools_summary.name: list_text_by_pattern
tools_summary.description: Find every piece of text in the drawing matching a pattern, WITHOUT changing anything. Reads all six places text lives - single-line text, MText, MLeaders, block attributes, table cells and dimension text overrides - and reports scannedByType, so 'no matches' in a drawing full of text can be told from 'no matches in the two types a lesser search bothered to look at'. Matching runs against the RENDERED text, not the stored string: a search over MText contents would hit words inside formatting codes and report matches nobody can see on the sheet. Set regex, matchCase or wholeWord as needed.

tools_summary.name: list_text_styles
tools_summary.description: List every text style defined in the active drawing plus the current style name.

tools_summary.name: mtext_column_settings
tools_summary.description: Flow an MText into columns. mode 'static' is a fixed number you choose, 'dynamic' lets AutoCAD use as many as the height allows, 'none' puts it back to one block. width is the width of ONE column, not the total, because the overall width becomes count times width plus the gutters. The result reports the drawn extent before and after, which is how you tell the text actually REFLOWED from a column count that was merely stored: splitting a block into columns makes it wider and shorter, and putting it back does the reverse.
intent: split a note into two columns

tools_summary.name: scale_text_in_place
tools_summary.description: Resize text about its OWN anchor point - AutoCAD's SCALETEXT. Every item holds still while it grows, which is what modify.scale cannot do: that one scales distances too, so a row of tags would bunch towards the base point as well as get bigger. Give either factor, which multiplies each text's own height and so keeps a mixed selection's relative sizes, or newHeight, which makes every one of them that height. The anchor is measured before and after and any drift is reported as a failure.

tools_summary.name: set_current_text_style
tools_summary.description: Set the active text style for new DBText / MText entities; subsequent text creation defaults to it.

tools_summary.name: set_table_cell
tools_summary.description: Set the text content of a single Table cell by (row, col), 0-based.

tools_summary.name: set_text_justification
tools_summary.description: Change which point anchors a piece of text WITHOUT moving the text - AutoCAD's JUSTIFYTEXT. Setting the justification on its own relocates the text, because the justification decides which point of it sits on the alignment point: same anchor, different meaning. This moves the anchor to match, and the extent is measured before and after so a text that shifted is reported as a failure rather than an edit. Accepts the Top, Middle, Bottom and Base rows against Left, Center and Right; the Base row sits on the BASELINE, where descenders hang below, and Bottom sits under them. Works on single-line text and MText.
intent: wyrownaj tekst do srodka bez przesuwania

tools_summary.name: text_fit
tools_summary.description: Stretch a single-line text to run exactly between two points - AutoCAD's TEXTFIT. The text is widened or narrowed while its HEIGHT stays put, which is the whole difference from scaling it, and the height is checked before and after. The text is left on AutoCAD's Fit alignment, so later edits to its contents re-stretch it between the same two points instead of overflowing them. MText is refused by name: it has a width of its own and wraps rather than stretching.

tools_summary.name: update_dbtext
tools_summary.description: Replace the contents of an existing DBText entity by handle.

tools_summary.name: update_mtext
tools_summary.description: Replace the contents string of an existing MText entity by handle. Inline formatting codes are preserved as written.
